# Camp Ally: Solomon Hardy

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Mar 8, 2023
- 1 min read

Updated: Jul 1, 2023

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1cbfc1ce987c49c9afd9781256ba8e4c~mv2.jpg)

#### **Type**

Lite Ally

Lite Allies do not offer a daily/repeatable quest, they are most often vendors and offer buffs in return for you letting them sleep at your camp.

#### **Specialises in**

Medical and Aid

#### **Faction**

Brotherhood of Steel (BOS)

#### **Lore**

Solomon's background can be found __here.__ 

#### **Camp Item**

Solomon's Medic Station

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_82b02c7322724358bfe864faab624655~mv2.jpg)

#### **Flamingo Units**

1x Flamingo Unit

Flamingo Unit camp item cost __spreadsheet__ 

#### **Obtainable from**

- Season 3 scoreboard - The Scribe of Avalon (free)
- Gold Bullion - Samuel at Foundation once you have reached Ally status with the Settlers (4000 Gold Bullion)
- Atom Shop - Solomon Hardy __Bundle__ (1800 atoms)

#### **Daily Quest**

N/A

#### **Buffs/Services**

24-hour cool down period on all buffs and services excluding the Well Rested/Lover's Embrace buff.

Well Rested - +5% XP for 3 hours

Solomon will charge you a fee for his other services.

**Removes Rads**

Cost: 20c

Removes: 300 Rads

Note: Solomon will warn you that you will lose your mutations unless you have extra resilience. ie Starched Genes equipped.

**Cures Disease**

Cost: 10c

Removes: One Disease

**Restores Health**

Cost: 10c

Restores: 1500 HP per second for 4 seconds

**Health Bar (HP)** 

534 HP
